newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET DAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET DAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies after Thursday's lacklustre interbank trading session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"To be quite honest nothing happened today and the dollar was very stable the whole day," one dealer said.
He said the local unit closed at 10.7550/7750 against the U.S. dollar, where it also finished the previous day.

On the crosses, it tracked a softer U.S. dollar overseas to end weaker against pound sterling at 18.0500/0700 compared to Wednesday's 18.0415/0950, while against Germany's mark it edged up to 7.0200/0400 from 7.0575/0740.
On the rand, it was quoted at 2.3400/3600 slightly firmer from 2.3570/3650 the previous day.
